checks.claim: Census QuickFacts supports Morton village city context, including the report's explicitly vintaged 2024 population estimate and the displayed 2020-2024 age shares, income, density, and commute facts.

retrieval.method: Direct public web fetch of Census QuickFacts plus a search of the indexed official Census QuickFacts V2024 result for the retained historical estimate.

checks.result: The live QuickFacts page now defaults to the newer July 1, 2025 estimate of 17,565. It still confirms 25.9% under 18, 23.1% age 65+, $94,402 median household income, 1,336.4 people per square mile, and a 16.6-minute commute. An indexed official Census QuickFacts V2024 result confirms 17,557 for July 1, 2024. The report labels that number as a 2024 city estimate, so the vintage difference does not contradict the report.
checks.limitations: The live endpoint is mutable and no frozen Census payload is stored in the packet. The 2024 estimate is historical rather than the current default. All values are city-boundary context, not drive-time catchment measurements.

checks.claim: The stored OSRM point-to-point receipt supports a 4.07-minute, 1.56-mile route from Vintage Optical to Focus On Eyes.

retrieval.method: Attempted direct public web fetch of the OSRM route URL; the retrieval layer returned an internal error. Audited the saved raw OSRM JSON receipt collected 2026-07-30 UTC and independently recomputed its displayed units.

checks.result: No live route verification is claimed. The saved response has code Ok, duration 244.3 seconds, and distance 2504.2 meters; these independently round to 4.07 minutes and 1.56 miles. The stored official-provider receipt is adequate for this internal point-route claim.
checks.limitations: The current endpoint response was not retrieved live. OSRM public routing has no live traffic or time-of-day model, routes can change, and this practice-origin point route is neither an isochrone nor a patient-origin choice set.

logic_check_details.evidence: All 5, 10, 15, 20, and 30-minute population, household, age, VDU, office, provider, and ratio fields are null. The PDF says city values do not describe the 20-minute catchment and labels 17,557 as city context.
Every fixed window sets known_routed_alternatives_is_complete_supply_count to false. The PDF calls the routes a bounded peer set, not a complete supply census or patient-origin choice set.
All 22 score components marked neutral_unknown_no_directional_claim equal 50. The report does not call 50 average, benchmark, or measured performance.
The extracted PDF has nine higher = better cues covering all visible score blocks. Room to Win is 100 minus hidden raw pressure.
Competitive Pressure Index 57 exists only in scores.json/internal metadata. Neither Competitive Pressure nor Pressure Index appears in extracted PDF text.
The PDF says public pages verify offers and access paths, not starts, visits, throughput, outcomes, or financial performance. No patient, revenue, or dollar forecast appears.
Dry eye, myopia, and specialty contacts are each labeled RESEARCH NEXT in the PDF and read research_next in scores.json.
All three cards define ratios or counts populated after 30-day measurement. Impact fields explicitly reject patient/revenue forecasts and assumed leakage.

The set contains three named Tier 1 peers and three named Tier 2 substitutes with match bases and limitations; Tier 3 is excluded, completeness flags are false, and the page does not call the set exhaustive.

The registry has 23 unique IDs. Scores, market inputs, competitor set, and all 20 unique visible IDs resolve with no unknown IDs. All 75 HTML citation occurrences match the URL registered for their displayed source ID.
